title: 第15章 赵庆国第16章 近道
lines: 跟随赵乾的脚步，我来到了二楼的那间病房里，赵星辰也在后面跟着，我并没有搭理她。
依然是那宽大的床边，只是现在赵乾的父亲已经直起了身子，靠在床头上，眼神平淡，让人看不出什么。
“小兄弟，你好，我是赵庆国，感谢你的到来。”
赵乾的父亲在看到我的到来以后，开口说道，他的声音带着沙哑，却中气十足，完全不像是一位老人的声音，更不像是一个位大病初愈的老人。
“您老客气了。”
我点头说道。
赵庆国示意我坐在一旁，又看了看赵星辰。
“辰辰你也坐吧。”
老人有些宠溺的对着赵星辰说道。
赵星辰乖巧的点了点头，那种淑女的模样看得我一愣一愣的。
房间的门被关上了，只剩下我们四人。
“小兄弟，你说我这是怎么了？”
赵庆国率先问道。
我摇了摇头。
“不好说，对了，您老之前跟人有什么仇吗？”
这是我最关心的，照我想法，赵乾的父亲肯定是得罪了什么人了，然后被人下套了。
可是赵庆国却摇了摇头。
“没有。”
我一愣，看了赵乾一眼。
赵乾看我不相信，只得解释道。
“虽然有些人可能真的跟我们有仇，但是他们也不会算计我父亲的，这点我敢保证。”
听着赵乾的话，我更疑惑了，姑且赵乾说的是真的，但是这明显就是得罪了什么人了！
我不死心。
“你老好好想想，是不是遗忘了什么？”
其实不光我疑惑，赵乾也是很奇怪，最后只得把目光放在赵庆国身上。
赵庆国作沉思状，想了很久，最终却摇了摇头。
“不记得了。”
一旁的赵星辰却眉头紧锁，最后轻轻的开口问道。
“爷爷，你记不记得你昏迷前，也就是去年，那天我非得缠着你去逛商场。”
赵星辰语气温柔的说道。
这轻柔的语气不由的让我侧目看了赵星辰一眼，感受到我的目光以后，赵星辰恶狠狠的瞪了我一眼，然后转头不去看我。
赵乾也很疑惑。
“逛商场？发生了什么？”
赵庆国眉头紧皱，最后恍然大悟。
“我想起来了，当时教训了一个出言不逊的毛小子。”
随后，赵星辰说起了前因后果。
那天赵星辰缠着他爷爷去上南市最大的购物中心去逛街，老爷子心疼孙女，也就去了，在商场买东西的时候，碰见了两位年轻人，其中一人见赵星辰长的漂亮，就上来搭讪。
起初赵星辰并没有在意，只是后来那人越来越过分，说的话也越来越露骨。
赵庆国当时并不在一旁，后来来到的时候，赶忙上前阻止，叫了保镖按住了那年轻人。
后来看到看热闹的人多了，赵庆国也不想把事情闹大，就放了那年轻人，这件事赵庆国根本没有放在心上。
“爷爷，你记得那个人一块来的那个人说的话吗？”
赵星辰看着赵庆国问道。
赵庆国摇了摇头。
“想不起来了。”
content_en:
Following Zhao Qian's footsteps, I arrived at the ward on the second floor. Zhao Xingchen followed behind, but I ignored her.
It was still the wide bedside, but now Zhao Qian's father had straightened up and leaned on the bedside, his eyes dull, making it difficult to tell anything.
"Hello, little brother, I am Zhao Qingguo. Thank you for coming."
After Zhao Qian's father saw my arrival, he spoke. His voice was hoarse but full of energy. It didn't sound like the voice of an old man at all, let alone an old man recovering from a serious illness.
"You're so polite."
I nodded and said.
Zhao Qingguo motioned for me to sit aside and looked at Zhao Xingchen again.
"Chenchen, please sit down too."
The old man said to Zhao Xingchen fondly.
Zhao Xingchen nodded obediently, with such a ladylike appearance that I was stunned for a moment.
The door to the room was closed, leaving only the four of us.
"Little brother, what do you think is wrong with me?"
Zhao Qingguo asked first.
I shook my head.
"It's hard to say. By the way, did you have any grudges against anyone before you got old?"
This is what I am most concerned about. According to my opinion, Zhao Qian's father must have offended someone and was tricked.
But Zhao Qingguo shook his head.
"No."
I was stunned and glanced at Zhao Qian.
Zhao Qian saw that I didn't believe it, so he had to explain.
"Although some people may really have grudges against us, they will not plot against my father. I can guarantee this."
Listening to Zhao Gan's words, I became even more confused. Although what Zhao Gan said was true, it was obvious that he had offended someone!
I don't give up.
"Think carefully, have you forgotten something?"
In fact, not only was I confused, but Zhao Qian was also very strange. In the end, I had to focus on Zhao Qingguo.
Zhao Qingguo was deep in thought, thinking for a long time, but finally shook his head.
"I don't remember."
Zhao Xingchen on the side frowned, and finally asked softly.
"Grandpa, do you remember that before you fell into coma, that is, last year, I had to pester you to go shopping that day?"
Zhao Xingchen said in a gentle tone.
This soft tone made me glance sideways at Zhao Xingchen. After feeling my gaze, Zhao Xingchen glared at me fiercely, and then turned away from me.
Zhao Qian was also confused.
"Walking to the mall? What happened?"
Zhao Qingguo frowned and finally realized something.
"I remembered that I taught a rude boy a lesson."
Later, Zhao Xingchen talked about the causes and consequences.
That day, Zhao Xingchen pestered his grandfather to go shopping in the largest shopping mall in Shangnan City. The old man felt sorry for his granddaughter, so he went there. While shopping in the mall, he met two young people. One of them saw that Zhao Xingchen was pretty, so he came up to chat with her.
Zhao Xingchen didn't pay attention at first, but then the man became more and more outrageous and his words became more and more explicit.
Zhao Qingguo was not there at the time. When he arrived later, he hurriedly stepped forward to stop him and called bodyguards to hold the young man down.
Later, when he saw that there were many people watching the excitement, Zhao Qingguo didn't want to make the matter a big deal, so he let the young man go. Zhao Qingguo didn't take this matter to heart at all.
"Grandpa, do you remember what the man who came with us said?"
Zhao Xingchen looked at Zhao Qingguo and asked.
Zhao Qingguo shook his head.
"I can't remember."
